title: Discovering Your Genjokoan Workshop
speaker: Myoki Raizelah Bayen
summary: The talk explores the nature of reality and the self, encouraging participants to let go of fixed perceptions and ego boundaries. Through various exercises, including writing, sharing, and collaboration, the teacher invites participants to touch reality and actualize the fundamental point that lies beyond conceptual thinking. By embracing impermanence and interconnectedness, participants can experience a deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them, and show up fully in the present moment.
